Round 4 is complete according to its tracked scope: 105 work-package files, 105 merged IDs, no missing or unexpected IDs. The audit-to-package mapping covers every original “must” finding except DT-23: history/publication cleanup, deliberately deferred until release.

References below use I = origin/claude/treams-rs-improvements-snetmh@1f8b607 (condensed into 8251007) and T = origin/r4-tooling@ea89629.

Priority Remaining work Evidence and recommendation
Release requirement Validate the final combined tree, then the distributable Round4 recorded 217 Rust tests and 4,905 Python passes / 22 skips, strict docs builds and numerical recordings, but not wheel builds, clean pip-from-git installation, Lean builds or deployed docs. T:status/final-report.md:9-15,104-105. These are historical results, not verification of the proposed merged tree.
Explicit release decision Accept or investigate remaining performance losses Final quiet-machine rerun reports backward power-tr 1.165, plane-operator 1.117, oriented-chirality 1.073; five other cases are 1.037–1.061. Owner previously stopped further investigation. Present this as a release acceptance decision; source cause remains unproven. T:status/final-report.md:56-82.
Evidence preservation Save final round4 records before deleting tooling refs The report points to an unavailable container, but the important final sweep files are committed: T:status/perf/sweep-9317d67.tsv (condensed into 8251007) and .rerun6.tsv. Preserve final report, decisions and these recordings privately before removing temporary refs.
Required reconciliation Integrate separate sessions and supersede obsolete decisions Round4 explicitly excluded release-readiness and multithreading branches. Its “keep history/authors unchanged” decisions are now superseded by the current request. T:status/final-report.md:107-117.
Optional pre-release polish Normalize remaining selector/argument names and Fresnel error type Native coordinate/metric selectors still use kind; public cylinder_tmatrix uses kz for multiple axial wavenumbers; unsupported batched coeffs.fresnel raises TypeError. These are known consistency issues, not unfinished numerical paths. T:status/final-report.md:97-100; I:python/treams_rs/_tmatrix.py:955; native coordinate/tmatrix bindings.
Optional API addition Add PeriodicResponse.valid_points No such method exists; gallery computes reference-cell exclusions with NumPy. Existing supported examples have a working path. Do not make a new convenience method a release blocker. T:status/final-report.md:101.

Already resolved; do not reopen from stale reports:

  • Multi-axis spherical-to-cylindrical conversion: implementation now applies axis_mask to outgoing and incident conversion matrices. I:python/treams_rs/_tmatrix.py:760-799.
  • R29/R29b lattice issues, R31 lattice timing loss, R56 EBCM regression, and R57 final documentation/word-list cleanup are all tracked as merged. Earlier python-open-issues.md / docs-report.md entries are stale.
  • golden_cases compatibility wrapper and obsolete property-budget re-exports are gone.
  • Jargon/private-wording tests are gone, as explicitly requested.
  • The 3D automatic Ewald split using (V^{1/3}), rather than treams’ (V^{2/3}), is an accepted scientific choice. T:plan/decisions.md:174.
  • Multi-origin expand / expandlattice all-pairs summation is accepted and documented, including possible double counting when the same field is expanded around multiple axes. I:docs/coming-from-treams/differences.md, “Spheres and cylinders at several positions.”
  • The reported missing internal Kambe guard is not an observed failure: Family::validate bounds degree at 128, the derived maximum derivative order is 259, and MAX_LABEL is 260. Keep validation at the authoritative input boundary; no redundant guard required. I:crates/treams-core/src/lattice/wave.rs:31-51, special/mod.rs:84-90.

Keep the intended release scope explicit: CPU, Python 3.12–3.13, first-order derivatives, documented numerical domains and limits. “Complete for release” need not mean adding accelerators, higher derivatives, unrestricted framework batching, arbitrary numerical accuracy, or upstream API compatibility. These limitations are already stated in I:docs/validation/capabilities.md and numerical-limits.md.

Prior owner preferences retain scientific attribution, reference tables, organized validation/performance evidence, concise agent docs, and neutralized agent-evaluation tooling. T:plan/decisions.md:24-26,35-37,73-77. Distinguish these intentional assets from temporary round4 orchestration branches when preparing cleanup.

Verified through read-only Git/source/report inspection and tracker reconciliation. No builds, tests, linters or scientific reruns; no files, branches, commits, pushes, PRs or comments changed.
